marketing.headline: Post-op care your clinic actually
marketing.subheadline: The clinic fills in the whole recovery plan on the website: medications, procedures and checkup visits — and it reaches the patient by email.

languages.label: Patient-facing in both languages from day one

push.label: Reminders reach the patient either way

setup.label: Patient, procedure and plan in one sitting

carePlan.label: Care plan
carePlan.title: Doses, tasks, checkups
carePlan.description: Build the whole post-op plan once: medications with dosing times, rehab tasks at light, moderate or intense levels, and the dates of every follow-up checkup.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.title: A notification, not a leaflet
reminders.description: Every item on the plan becomes a dated reminder — a push notification on the phone and an email to the patient's address.

adherence.label: Adherence
adherence.title: Proof the plan was followed
adherence.description: Done, skipped or missed — every occurrence is recorded, so the clinic sees how the recovery actually went.

assistant.title: Care assistant
assistant.emptyHint: Ask about your medicines, rehab tasks, or your next checkup.
assistant.disclaimer: This assistant explains the plan your clinic prescribed. It cannot judge symptoms or diagnose anything. Contact your clinic with any medical concern, and seek emergency care if something is severe or sudden.

recoveryGuide.title: Complications and what is normal
recoveryGuide.authoringHelp: Content you write here is shown to your patients in their portal. Nothing is generated automatically.
recoveryGuide.emergencyBanner: This is general guidance from your clinic, not a diagnosis. Contact your clinic with any concern. If something is severe or sudden, seek emergency care immediately.
recoveryGuide.reportSent: Sent. Your clinic will review it.
recoveryGuide.noGuide: Your clinic has not added guidance for this procedure yet.
recoveryGuide.sharedAcrossPatients: Written per procedure type — every patient with this procedure sees it.
recoveryGuide.usingDefault: Showing the default guide. Saving creates your clinic’s own version.
